title: gymnogramma fraxinea
intro: Gymnogramma fraxinea, commonly known as Tree Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
